newsitem.title: USA: AMBAC unit sold Mercury Finance holdings.
newsitem.headline: AMBAC unit sold Mercury Finance holdings.

text.p: AMBAC Inc said Friday that its investment financial adviser unit had sold all holdings of troubled Mercury Finance Co contained in state investment funds.

John Cathey, a spokesman for the bond insurer, read a statement that said Cadre Financial Services Inc, the adviser AMBAC acquired in December, no longer had any Mercury Finance commercial paper holdings in the government funds it runs for schools in Michigan and Illinois.

"Cadre Financial Services was able to arrange for the sale of the commercial paper at no loss to the funds," Cathey said. "AMBAC Inc has no exposure to Mercury Finance Co and the Cadre sales will have no impact on AMBAC's earnings," he added.
Cathey declined to comment on how much Mercury Finance commercial paper was owned by the funds or if the commercial paper were sold at a loss and if so who absorbed that loss.

Mercury Finance last week said it had to restate its last four year's earnings lower by a total of about $90 million after discovering accounting discrepancies. Later in the week, the consumer finance company said it was in default on its short-term lending agreements.
On Monday, the Federal Bureau of Investigation served a search warrant at the company's Lake Forest, Ill., headquarters seeking financial documents.
